valores.label: Record of Decision signed, Alternative 1 – No Action (June 18, 2018)

legenda: FHWA Record of Decision, signed by Sandra A. Garcia-Aline, Division Administrator.
nota: O ROD é decisão em primeira pessoa da FHWA, mas circula no volume estadual: sem prova de autoria federal, conta como estadual (midia.md §7.1). O aviso federal no Federal Register (83 FR 36661, 30/07/2018), citado na midia.md, não foi reaberto aqui.
narracao: The No Action alternative became final in June 2018… The 2018 decision pointed to the state's budget, and to a public fight over the road, a fight that was never settled.

conferencia.prova: lido na imagem: data manuscrita 'June 18, 2018'; "…it is also my decision to select Alternative 1 – No Action as the proposed action for this project."
